title: Sign the Contract
description: The Iron Company lost forty soldiers at Thornfield twelve years back and has never filled the roster back up. Captain Steele doesn't take just anyone to make the numbers - a recruit who breaks formation gets someone else killed, and he's buried enough of his own. He wants to see you take a beating from three training soldiers without running. That's the whole test.

objectives.description: Speak to Captain Steele about the open roster
Take the training soldiers down without breaking formation
Report to Captain Steele and see if you made it

notes: Threat: the Company has been short-handed since Thornfield (established in captain_roderick_steele.json dialogue - forty dead, twelve years ago) and every thin contract is a soldier they can't spare. Giver motive: Steele isn't testing swordplay, he's testing whether you'll hold formation and not get someone killed. Consequence: fails to land mechanically - there is no world state for 'Company stays short-handed' - this quest can only succeed or not exist yet.
